query: Keyboard users can't get to the chart filters.

mode_evidence: accessibility: accessibility defect on existing UI

required.reason: accessibility mode: operability is part of the review
numbers, tables or charts are the content

required_concepts.reason: named in the request: keyboard user

core.title: Chart container and interaction
covers: chart form chosen from the analytical question
accessible chart summary and table alternative
core.guidance: Title that states the question, unit and time range visible, legend as direct labels where possible, tooltip also keyboard-reachable (focusable points or a data table toggle), accessible summary text, consistent palette, responsive (reduce ticks, not data), empty/loading/error states, no animation beyond a single load transition and none on data refresh. Provide the data table or CSV.
core.avoid_when: Decorative charts with no question; charts of fewer than ~4 points (use a stat).

implementation.react: Recharts/Visx/ECharts already in the project; add role=img + aria-label summary and a table fallback.

core.title: Filter bar / faceted filters
covers: applied filters as removable chips with counts
core.guidance: Desktop: filter row above the content with chips for applied filters; facets as popovers with checkboxes and counts; 'clear all'; results update with a count. Mobile: filter button with badge count opens a sheet; apply button; applied chips under the search field. Persist in URL.
core.avoid_when: One or two filters (inline selects); TV (use rail categories or a simple filter row).

guardrails.title: Search and filters: visible state and instant feedback
covers: applied filters as removable chips with counts
guardrails.guidance: Applied filters as removable chips with a 'clear all', result count announced, debounced query (≈300 ms) with a loading indicator, empty results suggest next steps, filter state in the URL/route, and on TV a search screen with a system keyboard/voice plus results as rails.
guardrails.use_when: Catalogues, tables, media libraries, admin lists.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never hide applied filters; never reset filters on navigation without asking; never search on every keystroke against a slow backend without debounce.
guardrails.selected_for: most relevant record for the request wording

guardrails.title: Everything operable by keyboard, no traps
guardrails.guidance: Tab reaches every control in visual order; composite widgets use arrow keys with a roving tabindex so Tab is not consumed by every cell; Escape closes layers and returns focus to the invoker; nothing traps focus except a modal, and the modal itself must be escapable. Provide a keyboard alternative for every drag interaction.
guardrails.use_when: Every interactive element, including custom widgets, drag/drop, sliders, menus, date pickers, and anything that appears on hover.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: interaction, keyboard navigation and focus order

guardrails.title: Semantic structure: headings, landmarks, lists, tables
guardrails.guidance: Structure first, style second: choose the element for its meaning and restyle it. Data tables use <th scope>; layout tables are forbidden; visually hidden headings are fine for screen readers when the visual design omits them.
guardrails.use_when: Every page: one h1, ordered heading levels, main/nav/aside landmarks, real <button>/<a>/<table>, lists for lists.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never use divs with click handlers as buttons; never use heading levels for visual size.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: semantic structure and roles

guardrails.title: Non-text contrast 3:1 for controls and focus
guardrails.guidance: Any visual that identifies a control or its state needs ≥3:1 against adjacent colours. Hairline dividers at 1.2:1 are fine as decoration but an input whose only boundary is that hairline fails.
guardrails.use_when: Input borders, checkbox/radio outlines, focus indicators, icons that carry meaning, chart marks, toggle states.
guardrails.avoid_when: Purely decorative borders and dividers are exempt, but then they must not be the only boundary of a control.

guardrails.title: Accessible names for every control and image
guardrails.guidance: Visible label for inputs (not placeholder-only), aria-label/accessibilityLabel/contentDescription/AutomationProperties.Name for icon-only controls, alt text for meaningful images and alt="" for decorative ones, link text that makes sense out of context. The accessible name must contain the visible label text (label in name).
guardrails.use_when: Icon-only buttons, inputs, images, custom controls, links whose text is 'Read more'.
guardrails.avoid_when: Decorative images and icons beside visible text are hidden from assistive tech instead.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: accessible names and labels

guardrails.title: Never colour alone
covers: selected state visible and distinct from focus and hover
guardrails.guidance: Pair colour with text, icon, pattern, weight, or underline. Error fields get an icon and message; chart series get labels or line styles; links in prose get underlines; selected rows get a check or a border, not only a tint.
guardrails.use_when: Status, validation errors, chart series, selected/active states, required fields, links inside text.
guardrails.selected_for: specialist rule for no colour alone for status (only covered by a composite record)
